messages: Ivy (PM): Quick follow-up from usability testing — people expect 'Version' not 'Tag' in the Models table; help links jump to a section called '#pinning' which doesn't match the visible label. Rowan (Design): We compressed the label to 'Tag' for density. Agree we should standardize. Proposal: visible label 'Version', compact inline link 'How to pin a version' that goes to #pinning. Jules (Docs): Docs canonical term is 'model version'. I'll add an explicit H2 id '#pinning' and a small alias anchor '' before it so legacy fragments still land correctly. Also adding a one-line header note: "Console shows 'Version' (formerly 'Tag')." Kai (Eng): Implementation notes: changing text is trivial. Fragments are client-side so Jules' hidden anchor approach is correct. We'll keep telemetry event name model_tag_click to avoid breaking dashboards; map the label in the UI telemetry layer. I'll add aria-label 'How to pin a model version' for the link and ensure keyboard focus lands on the H2. Rowan (Design): Accessibility: tooltip (if we add one) must be reachable via keyboard and referenced with aria-describedby. Link text must be descriptive for screen readers. I'll update the Figma microcopy with two variants. Jules (Docs): I'll open a docs PR with the alias anchor and glossary synonym for 'tag' and 'variant'. ETA: today. Kai (Eng): I'll create a tiny feature branch for the UI change and add an e2e test: click the inline link -> assert URL ends with '#pinning' and document.activeElement is the H2. DocBot: checklist: docs-pr: open soon, ui-branch: created, qa-ticket: QA-5123. Ivy (PM): Great — ship in next minor. Please ping here when PRs are merged or if any regressions appear. :thumbsup:
